description: This file defines a REST API resource for self-service registration within the Fineract project. It provides endpoints to create registration requests and self-service users, utilizing dependency-injected services and leveraging annotations for routing, serialization, and conditional activation.

classes.name: SelfServiceRegistrationApiResource
classes.description: API resource class exposing endpoints for self-service registration and user creation, conditionally enabled based on a configuration condition.

methods.name: createSelfServiceRegistrationRequest
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a self-service registration request using provided JSON payload.

methods.name: createSelfServiceUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a self-service user and returns serialized result.
